title: Open Source Agentic Workflows with Local AI
description: Learn to build open-source AI agents using no-code and code approaches with tools like O Lama and N8N. Explore financial analysis and email handling use cases.
key_points: 1. Open source AI allows local hosting for privacy and cost savings.
2. No-code tools like O Lama and N8N enable building agentic workflows without coding.
3. Code approach using Python and OpenAI agents SDK offers flexibility for complex tasks.
4. Financial analysis and email handling are practical applications demonstrated.
5. Community bootcamps and tutorials provide structured learning paths.
